label.zh: 局势阶段（按进度依次出现）

note.zh: 深挖局势进度0–500：依次为“失忆与数据”“生命维持失败”“远古监狱”“悲剧事故”；每月基础+1，三种方针改变速度。
note.en: Deep Excavation progress 0–500 runs through “Amnesia and Data”, “Life Support Failure”, “An Ancient Prison” and “A Tragic Accident”; +1 a month, approaches change speed.

note.zh: 2540的选项：强攻（2545）或贿赂（2550）；二者都会暂停局势。
note.en: Options of 2540: storm the facility (2545) or bribe it (2550); both pause the situation (:3353-3520).

label.en: Four ways of salvaging the situation

note.zh: 2555的四个选项各导向一个窗口（蜂巢思维与个体帝国文本不同）。
note.en: Each option of 2555 leads to one window (hive and non-hive texts differ) (:3520-3805).

notes.zh: 开局时母星人口被削减为沉眠，居民在休眠舱中；项目“钻探地壳”完成后2505“更多族人苏醒”开始局势“深挖”。
notes.en: At start six pop groups are dead and five stasis pods wait on the homeworld; the Drilling the Crust project leads to 2505 More Kin Awaken, which starts the situation Deep Excavation.

uncertain: The cosmic-dawn variants inside generic colony events (colony.9055, 8232) are associations only.
Which survey outcome opens which option of 2530 / 2535 was not traced.
